chunks: God is sufficient, and sufficient is His Messenger.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Kafa billahi' mean in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this creedal statement as a foundational pillar of Twelver Shi'ism, asserting that the Imam serves as the necessary, living proof (*hujjah*) of God on earth, ensuring the continuity of divine guidance after the Prophet. This affirmation underscores the theological necessity of the Imam's infallibility and authority for the spiritual sufficiency of the believers, distinguishing Shi'a belief from other sects regarding the source of post-prophetic guidance.
